coordinate_system: Original source image resized uniformly by 1/4 from 3840x2160; x rightward, y downward; frame indices are zero based. Landing point approximates cork/floor contact; trajectory points approximate visible shuttle center.
reference_inspection_method: Original source sequential frames and native crops decoded from frame 0 with OpenCV VideoCapture two threads. No frame seeking. No pipeline predictions or previous AI annotations were inspected. Both original camera views were inspected independently and cross-checked by rally sequence.

later_bounce_observations.notes: A later small floor bounce after the first landing; distinguish it from the initial descent/contact.

notes: AI visual estimate, not human ground truth.

The tracked main-court shuttle descends on the far side of the net, just left of the nearer navy-shirt player in image space. The near player briefly occludes the earlier flight, but the final descent and rebound are visible in native source crops.
The first landing is the reversal near frame 132; a later small bounce is visible near frame 159. The apparent crossing of the net cord in image space before contact is not a floor landing.
Adjacent-court rallies and static loose shuttles around the net/court divider are unrelated to this main-court trajectory.
